items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: over on La Cienega, just before you get to Hollywood Boulevard there's a club over there, and Jack Palance used to sit in a booth every night, (Unintelligible), and we kept the place packed all the time.

ctx.x: Then -- yeah, during this period, because, see, in '53, Jimmy Rowles and Irv Cottler and I had a trio together,

over on La Cienega, just before you get to Hollywood Boulevard there's a club over there, and Jack Palance used to sit in a booth every night, (Unintelligible), and we kept the place packed all the time. We were playing all of Count Basie's tunes, you know, "Jiving at Five", and --
What was the name of that? I don't remember that.
